description: This file defines an abstract class 'Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar' which is part of the Zend Framework's XML-RPC Value package. It provides functionality for generating XML representations of scalar values in XML-RPC, specifically the '_generateXml' method.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar
classes.description: Abstract class representing scalar types in the XML-RPC value system, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Value and providing XML generation for scalar values.

methods.name: _generateXml
methods.description: Generates the XML representation of a scalar native XML-RPC value by opening and closing the corresponding XML elements.
